name: The MasterMind
summary: The MasterMind is a Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover previous losses with a single winning trade. It enters positions based on simple directional signals and relies on the Martingale progression to achieve net profitability. The strategy carries significant risk of account blow-up during extended losing streaks.
summary_zh: The MasterMind是一个基于马丁格尔策略的EA，每次亏损后将手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利来恢复之前的所有亏损。它基于简单的方向信号入场，依赖马丁格尔递进实现净盈利。该策略在连续亏损期间存在爆仓的重大风险。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典马丁格尔策略，核心逻辑是在每次交易亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，从而在赢一次时覆盖之前所有累计亏损并获利。入场条件通常基于简单的技术指标信号（如移动均线交叉或动量方向判断）来决定做多或做空方向。出场条件为固定止盈目标，当累计盈利达到预设值时平仓；止损通常缺失或设置较宽，依赖马丁格尔加仓来弥补亏损。仓位管理严格遵循2倍递增规则（1,2,4,8,16...），但缺乏最大手数限制和最大层级限制。资金管理方面没有最大回撤保护机制，在连续亏损序列中账户暴露于指数级增长的风险之下，可能导致账户资金迅速耗尽。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a classic Martingale strategy where the core logic doubles the lot size after each consecutive losing trade, aiming to recover all accumulated losses with a single winning trade. Entry conditions are typically based on simple technical indicator signals such as moving average crossovers or momentum direction to determine whether to go long or short. Exit conditions consist of a fixed take-profit target that closes the position when the net profit reaches a predefined level; stop-loss is often absent or set very wide, relying on the Martingale progression to compensate for losses. Position sizing strictly follows the doubling sequence (1, 2, 4, 8, 16...) but lacks a maximum lot size cap and a maximum level limit. Money management does not incorporate a maximum drawdown protection mechanism, leaving the account exposed to exponentially growing risk during extended losing streaks that can rapidly deplete the entire account balance.

parameters.name: InitialLot
parameters.description: 初始手数，马丁格尔序列的起始值
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, starting value for Martingale sequence

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: 亏损后手数乘数，典型值为2倍

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，达到后平仓获利

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MaxOrders
parameters.description: 最大订单数限制，0表示无限制

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 逻辑简单直观，易于理解和部署
在短期震荡行情中可能表现良好，赢一次即可回本
初始手数较小可控，适合小资金账户试运行
代码结构清晰，参数化设计便于调优
pros_en: Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and deploy
May perform well in short-term ranging markets where a single win recovers losses
Small initial lot size provides controllable risk at the starting level
Clean code structure with parameterized design for easy tuning
cons: 马丁格尔策略本质上是高风险的，连续亏损会导致手数指数级增长
缺乏止损保护，单方向极端行情可能导致账户爆仓
没有最大回撤限制和最大加仓层级保护
在强趋势行情中极度脆弱，逆势加仓会加速亏损
长期期望值为负，不构成可持续的交易系统
cons_en: Martingale strategy is inherently high-risk; consecutive losses cause exponential lot size growth
Lack of stop-loss protection means a strong unidirectional move can blow up the account
No maximum drawdown limit or maximum Martingale level protection
Extremely vulnerable in strong trending markets as counter-trend position sizing accelerates losses
Negative long-term expected value, does not constitute a sustainable trading system
improvements: 添加最大马丁格尔层级限制和最大手数上限，防止无限加仓
加入最大回撤保护机制，当回撤超过阈值时停止交易
引入趋势过滤器，避免在强趋势行情中逆势加仓
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale level limit and maximum lot size cap to prevent unlimited position scaling
Implement a maximum drawdown protection mechanism that halts trading when drawdown exceeds a threshold
Introduce a trend filter to avoid adding counter-trend positions during strong trending markets

risk_points: 马丁格尔手数翻倍机制在连续亏损时导致指数级风险增长
无止损或止损过宽，极端行情下可能一次亏损耗尽账户
缺乏最大层级和最大回撤保护，账户安全完全取决于市场方向
逆势加仓在强趋势行情中会加速爆仓进程
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling mechanism causes exponential risk growth during consecutive losses
No stop-loss or excessively wide stop-loss can deplete the account in a single extreme move
Absence of maximum level and maximum drawdown protection leaves account safety entirely dependent on market direction
Counter-trend position scaling accelerates account blow-up during strong trending markets

It enters positions based on simple directional signals and relies on the Martingale progression to achieve net profitability. The strategy carries significant risk of account blow-up during extended losing streaks.
